result.title: A Self-Exploring and Self-Evolving Paradigm for Adaptive Edge AI Development
result.summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) exhibit powerful code generation abilities, fostering agentic systems to automate edge AI application development. However, existing agents typically operate via fixed agentic workflows and predefined design spaces, struggling to handle rapidly evolving demands of real-world scenarios (e.g., heterogeneous data modalities, diverse task pipelines). Unlike prior systems that treat LLMs mainly as code generators following rigid workflows, we fully exploit their reasoning capabilities to allow agents to determine their own workflows on the fly. To this end, we propose SE2, a self-exploring and self-evolving paradigm for adaptive edge AI development. Inspired by human learning processes, we distill development into four atomic operations (retrieve, reason, code, test), and empower agents to explore workflows by dynamically and adaptively selecting an appropriate next operation based on the current context. Extensive evaluations show that, with adaptive workflows, the synthesized programs achieve up to 26% higher accuracy and consume 28% lower resources than state-of-the-art baselines, while maintaining superior adaptability to unforeseen edge AI scenarios. This highlights the potential of reasoning-driven adaptive agentic workflow in edge AI development.

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出 SE2 范式，将边缘 AI 开发拆成 retrieve、reason、code、test 四个原子操作，让 LLM 智能体根据上下文动态选择操作序列，从而自适应地生成和部署边缘 AI 程序，并报告了精度与资源开销的改进。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是面向边缘部署的代码生成智能体工作流编排，不涉及视觉或多模态推理中的内部状态表示、视觉证据使用或 latent 推理，其「动态选择下一步操作」属于任务级流程调度，与 THINK/LOOK/STOP 式的推理状态与停止决策缺少实质联系。
